name: Greedy detour: the best-looking edge is expensive
note: h is admissible (S 3, A 1, B 2, G 0). A has the smaller h, so Best First and Hill Climbing go S–A–G: 3 picks, cost 11. The cheap route S–B–G costs 4; Best First never compares it because it ignores the cost already paid (g). UCS and A* find S–B–G (cost 4).
